title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: Connected Spanish-language dental ERP prototype for fictional Clínica Dental Andina, with one sourced shell and in-memory records reset by reload/logout. Complete master CRUD with clear per-field columns and reference protection: patients with editable unique identity documents separate from immutable link IDs; physicians/specialties/rooms; descriptive Nombre/Descripción-only Laboratorio and Imagenología; Enfermedades/Alergias; priced Aranceles services; inventory; configurable staff roles; dedicated Medicamentos reference catalog. Triage removed. Clinical documentation uses human-selected disease and medicine references, manual notes/instructions/recommendations, detached row drafts, explicit textual Guardar progreso/Completar controls, atomic validation and read-only name/text snapshots after completion; no automatic diagnosis, drug, dose or advice. Studies and prescriptions never charge: only explicitly selected clinic services produce integer-cent order lines, settled by cash/non-payable simulated QR with idempotent receipts. Fully paid orders retain detail/receipts without QR/payment launchers or no-balance filler. Outgoing Pagos ledger drives financial Resumen. Configuración→Navegación independently selects the role to configure its menu/content grants; Simular rol inspects active visibility. Strict grants intersect personal menu preferences, Resumen content capabilities are name-independent and personalization can only narrow access. Accessible unique icons, 8px action spacing/44px targets, readable modal/config/clinical actions, upper-right Agregar+, responsive drawer/focus/tooltips. Author HTTP2239 plus reviewer-authored independent53 checks passed with zero forbidden API/storage/external operations or page errors; actual interactive URL50236 native-click acceptance passed. No native authority approval or production clinical/payment/security readiness.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: One preserved interactive prototype with full connected CRUD, scheduling, structured human clinical drafts and service-only billing/receipts. Clear identity and catalog columns, free descriptive studies, dedicated Medicine CRUD and no Triage. Role-specific menu/Resumen grants live in Navigation; only authorized blocks can be personalized. All actions preserve accessible text/icon rules, source tokens, positive icon gaps and mobile usability. Author2239 and independent53 checks plus actual HTTP delivery acceptance passed. Client-side simulation does not protect the downloadable fictional payload; no production backend/authentication, real prescriptions/payments or durable state.
